title: Population-Aligned Persona Generation for LLM-based Social Simulation
abstract: arXiv:2509.10127v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have enabled large-scale, high-fidelity social simulations, creating new opportunities for computational social science. However, constructing persona sets that faithfully reflect real-world population diversity remains a key challenge. Existing studies often emphasize agentic frameworks and simulation environments, while paying less attention to persona generation and the biases introduced by unrepresentative persona sets. In this paper, we propose a systematic framework for synthesizing high-quality, population-aligned persona sets for LLM-driven social simulation. Our approach begins by leveraging LLMs to generate narrative personas from long-term social media data, followed by rigorous quality assessment to filter out low-fidelity profiles. We then apply importance sampling to achieve global alignment with reference psychometric distributions, such as the Big Five personality

translated_title: 面向基于大语言模型社会模拟的种群对齐式人格生成
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）的最新进展使得大规模、高保真度的社会模拟成为可能，为计算社会科学创造了新的机遇。然而，构建能够忠实反映现实世界人口多样性的角色（persona）集合仍然是一个关键挑战。现有研究往往强调智能体框架和模拟环境，而对角色生成以及不具代表性的角色集合所引入的偏差关注较少。本文提出了一个系统性框架，用于为LLM驱动的社会模拟合成高质量、与种群对齐的角色集合。我们的方法首先利用LLM从长期社交媒体数据中生成叙事型角色，随后通过严格的质量评估来过滤低保真度的角色档案。接着，我们应用重要性采样来实现与参考心理测量分布（如大五人格）的全局对齐。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个系统性框架，通过从长期社交媒体数据生成叙事型角色、质量评估过滤低保真档案、并利用重要性采样与大五人格等参考心理测量分布对齐，来合成高质量且与真实人口分布对齐的角色集合，从而提升LLM社会模拟的真实性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a systematic framework for synthesizing high-quality, population-aligned persona sets for LLM-based social simulation, by generating narrative personas from long-term social media data, filtering low-fidelity profiles through rigorous quality assessment, and applying importance sampling to achieve global alignment with reference psychometric distributions such as the Big Five personality traits.
